source_description: Manually curated ECM cycle dates extracted from Armstrong Economics charts via image analysis. Each entry has a category and tag for app-side filtering. Dates from labeled-decimal-year charts are high confidence. Dates from monthly/yearly timing array grids are medium confidence (inferred from color-coded blocks).
